items.evidence: 330 modules expose the same build/validate/report/write pattern.
items.recommendation: Move shared lifecycle/report contracts into one base protocol before activation.
items.title: Scaffold families duplicate lifecycle/reporting code

items.evidence: 353 scaffold modules are not consumed by a live workflow.
items.recommendation: Build a governed vertical workflow trace before more module expansion.
items.title: Architecture leaves are not vertically integrated

items.evidence: Local answer scripts directly route to many phase-specific handlers.
items.recommendation: Route manual answers through a kernel transaction envelope in report-only mode.
items.title: Kernel does not yet enforce a single runtime execution path

items.evidence: ARC III builds reasoning context from ARC II checkpoint data.
items.recommendation: Introduce a read-only substrate query adapter consumed by reasoning.
items.title: Knowledge substrate and reasoning layer are connected by sample fixtures, not live query adapters

items.evidence: V31, ARC IV, and later completion modules each describe integration readiness.
items.recommendation: Unify proposal, review, approval, overwatch, integration simulation, and rollback state names.
items.title: Approval/integration states exist without one consolidated state machine
